tool_input.command:
q() { docker exec postgres psql -U postgres -d cchist -A -F '|' -t -c "$1"; }
echo c02; q "SELECT count(*) AS n FROM cchist.public.tool_result r JOIN cchist.public.tool_call c ON c.call_id = r.call_id WHERE c.tool_name = 'Write' AND r.is_error AND NOT r.denied_mark AND NOT r.validation_mark"
echo c05; q "SELECT count(*) AS n FROM cchist.public.tool_result r JOIN cchist.public.tool_call c ON c.call_id = r.call_id WHERE c.tool_name = 'Bash' AND r.denied_mark"
echo c08; q "SELECT count(*) AS n FROM cchist.public.human_message h JOIN cchist.public.message_pattern_hit p ON p.msg_id = h.msg_id WHERE NOT h.is_sidechain AND NOT h.is_noise AND h.chars > 0 AND p.pattern_id BETWEEN 16 AND 17"
echo c11; q "SELECT 100.0 * (SELECT count(*) FROM cchist.public.tool_result r JOIN cchist.public.tool_call c ON c.call_id = r.call_id WHERE c.tool_name = 'Bash' AND r.is_error AND NOT r.denied_mark AND NOT r.validation_mark) / NULLIF((SELECT count(*) FROM cchist.public.tool_call c WHERE c.tool_name = 'Bash'), 0) AS pct"
echo c14; q "SELECT count(*) AS n FROM cchist.public.tool_call c WHERE c.tool_name IN ('Edit', 'Write', 'NotebookEdit', 'MultiEdit') AND c.is_sidechain"
echo n02; q "SELECT count(*) AS n FROM cchist.public.tool_result r JOIN cchist.public.tool_call c ON c.call_id = r.call_id WHERE c.tool_name = 'Read' AND r.is_error"
echo n05; q "WITH c AS (SELECT h.file_id, h.line_no, h.chars < 400 AND (h.ends_with_q OR h.question_start) AND NOT h.imperative AS is_q, lead(h.line_no) OVER (PARTITION BY h.file_id ORDER BY h.line_no) AS next_line FROM cchist.public.human_message h WHERE NOT h.is_sidechain AND NOT h.is_noise AND h.chars > 0) SELECT count(*) AS n FROM c WHERE c.is_q AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM cchist.public.tool_call t WHERE t.file_id = c.file_id AND t.line_no > c.line_no AND (c.next_line IS NULL OR t.line_no < c.next_line) AND NOT t.is_sidechain)"
echo n08; q "SELECT count(*) AS n FROM cchist.public.tool_call c WHERE c.tool_name = 'Read' AND c.is_sidechain"
echo n11; q "SELECT 100.0 * (SELECT count(*) FROM cchist.public.tool_result r JOIN cchist.public.tool_call c ON c.call_id = r.call_id WHERE c.tool_name = 'Read' AND r.is_error AND NOT r.denied_mark AND NOT r.validation_mark AND c.model = 'claude-opus-4-8') / NULLIF((SELECT count(*) FROM cchist.public.tool_call c WHERE c.tool_name = 'Read' AND c.model = 'claude-opus-4-8'), 0) AS pct"
echo n14; q "SELECT count(*) AS n FROM cchist.public.tool_call c WHERE NOT c.is_sidechain AND c.model = 'claude-sonnet-4-6'"
echo m02_result_ts; q "SELECT count(*) AS n FROM cchist.public.tool_result r JOIN cchist.public.tool_call c ON c.call_id = r.call_id WHERE c.tool_name = 'Read' AND r.is_error AND NOT r.denied_mark AND NOT r.validation_mark AND r.ts >= TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-07-01 00:00:00+00' AND r.ts < TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-08-01 00:00:00+00'"
echo m02_call_ts; q "SELECT count(*) AS n FROM cchist.public.tool_result r JOIN cchist.public.tool_call c ON c.call_id = r.call_id WHERE c.tool_name = 'Read' AND r.is_error AND NOT r.denied_mark AND NOT r.validation_mark AND c.ts >= TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-07-01 00:00:00+00' AND c.ts < TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-08-01 00:00:00+00'"
echo m05; q "SELECT count(*) AS n FROM cchist.public.human_message h JOIN cchist.public.message_pattern_hit p ON p.msg_id = h.msg_id WHERE NOT h.is_sidechain AND NOT h.is_noise AND h.chars > 0 AND p.pattern_id BETWEEN 12 AND 15 AND h.model LIKE 'claude-opus-%'"
echo m08; q "SELECT count(*) AS n FROM cchist.public.call_danger_hit d JOIN cchist.public.tool_call c ON c.call_id = d.call_id WHERE NOT c.is_sidechain"
echo checks_null_is_sidechain; q "SELECT is_sidechain, count(*) FROM tool_call GROUP BY 1"
echo checks_read_results; q "SELECT count(*), count(DISTINCT r.call_id), count(*) FILTER (WHERE r.call_id IS NULL) FROM tool_result r"
echo checks_danger; q "SELECT count(*), count(*) FILTER (WHERE c.call_id IS NULL) FROM call_danger_hit d LEFT JOIN tool_call c ON c.call_id=d.call_id"
tool_input.description: Run certified and adapted queries for each question
